data.preprocessing: original patient_z plus TRAIN-only imputer/StandardScaler; immutable sealed FIT/VAL banks; NPZ y member never loaded

scorer.shared: exact original PRMLP network initialization seeded 42+1009*fold, teacher original oof_plan seed; no final-checkpoint warm start
scorer.V: CPU dedicated Generator seed42+7000+training_seed, Normal(0,0.01), does not consume training RNG

training.order: default_rng(seed+epoch) permutation of sorted TRAIN patients
training.loss: mean BCEWithLogits, pos_weight=TRAIN EZcount/NEZcount; one update per patient
training.regularizer: mean(V^2) + mean_g[w_g*(mean(u_g^2)+b_g^2)]; w_g=(N_TRAIN/4)/max(n_TRAIN_g,1), not renormalized; absent source u/b receive no BCE and remain zero
training.threshold: original .005 grid, patient MF1/EZF1/pooled BA/proximity .5/smaller tau
training.device: cuda; original PyTorch312 runtime; CPU tests/replay

oof.plan: exact uas_core.oof_plan; query excluded from TRAIN and internal selection; all members outer FIT only
oof.D1: hash-verified PR-UAS original hard-label teachers freshly evaluated deterministically, never MC means
oof.D3: 20 new D2 teachers exact formal architecture/loss/optimization; own TRAIN preprocessor

density.family: two Gaussian class means, common variance, NEZ logit normalized within patient median/IQR floor1e-5
density.moments: mean of each eligible patient's class mean and class second moment; class contributes only if present; two class variances equally averaged; common variance recomputed from shrunk second moments
density.shrinkage: each class first/second raw moment uses its unique class-bearing source patient count/(count+10); source prior uses all unique source FIT patients/(count+10)
density.adequacy: at least3 distinct class-bearing source patients in each class; raw and shrunk EZmean<NEZmean; else global density fallback; source prior retained when known
density.global: require >=3 class-bearing patients per class and EZmean<NEZmean else block; never force means apart
density.prior: patient mean label EZ fraction; source shrunk global, kappa20, alpha=1+20*pi, beta=1+20*(1-pi)
density.ece_bins: 10 fixed equally spaced probability bins [0,1], frozen FIT definition; patient-equal ECE/Brier; OOF-fit evaluation optimistic

map.solver: strictly concave log-domain objective derivative bisection, at most100 steps, bracket width<=1e-12; endpoints only if derivative sign excludes root
map.initialization: full fixed bracket, deterministic; no label inputs
map.failure: fixed source prior, count; no family replacement

decoder.objective: ratio of expected confusion counts, NOT exact expected F1
decoder.ties: exact float64 maximum, smaller k; canonical channel identity for equal q; preserve original logit order when numerical saturation ties arise

evaluation.ranking: original NEZ probability for D0/D2; D1/D3 ranking via monotone posterior log-odds, verify parity with corresponding scorer; no sigmoid saturation induced ordering changes
evaluation.fixed_prior: required diagnostic only, not fifth formal arm
evaluation.bootstrap: 10000 seed42 paired unique-ID clusters, retain all appearances; no threshold reoptimization

gate.numerical: no nonfinite inference, no solver failures, valid global ordering, known sources covered by global fallback if needed; fallback proportion disclosed, no posthoc cutoff

terminal_order: POSTERIOR_IDENTIFIABILITY_FAILED if either global posterior lacks FIT ordering
D3_DEVELOPMENT_TARGET_0P70_REACHED if all continuation gates pass and D3>=.700
SOURCE_CONDITIONING_ONLY_SUPPORTED if D2-D0>=.020, EZF1/AP nondecline and>=4 positive folds while combined gate fails
POSTERIOR_DECODER_ONLY_SUPPORTED if D1-D0>=.020, EZF1/AP nondecline and>=4 positive folds while combined/source gates fail
NO_MEANINGFUL_IMPROVEMENT otherwise; CIs always reported, supported means fixed exploratory continuation not clinical proof
public: source, hashes, compact non-identifying aggregates only
